import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_new_adult_group_enrollment.csv')
filtered = df[(df['State'] == 'Totals') & 
              (df['Updated Year'] == 2026) & 
              (df['Updated Month'] == 2) & 
              (df['Enrollment Year'] == 2025) & 
              (df['Enrollment Month'] == 6)]
val = filtered['Total Medicaid Enrollees'].iloc[0]
result = int(str(val).replace(',', '').strip())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('medicaid_new_adult_group_enrollment.csv')
states = ['Ohio', 'New Jersey', 'Pennsylvania']
filtered = df[(df['State'].isin(states)) & 
              (df['Updated Year'] == 2020) & 
              (df['Updated Month'] == 2) & 
              (df['Enrollment Year'] == 2018) & 
              (df['Enrollment Month'] == 9)]
result = int(filtered['Total VIII Group Newly Eligible Enrollees'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float).sum())
